verses.html: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.text: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.html: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.text: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.html: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.text: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

verses.html: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.html: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.text: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.html: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
verses.text: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

verses.html: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.text: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.html: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.text: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

verses.html: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.text: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

verses.html: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.text: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.html: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.html: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
verses.text: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
